claims.content: To enable the Auctioneer to create new auction events by selecting inventory items and configuring their sale parameters.

goal.raw_text: To enable the Auctioneer to create new auction events by selecting inventory items and configuring their sale parameters.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Administration system.
Inventory items exist in the system and are available for selection (e.g., 'Auction Eligible').
The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Create New Auctions' page within the Auction Administration system.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Create New Auctions' page within the Auction Administration system.

claims.content: The system displays the 'Create New Auctions' page, showing a list of inventory items with details such as Product ID, Description, Gemstone, Material Type, and Vendor.
The Auctioneer selects one or more inventory items from the list to include in the new auction event.
The Auctioneer configures sale parameters for the selected items, including setting the Start Time, End Time, Duration, and Reserve Price (either as a percentage of cost or a fixed dollar amount).
The Auctioneer may apply a profile to the selected items to bulk-configure settings like duration or reserve type.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Create New Auction' button to finalize and schedule the auction event.
The system processes the request, creates the auction event(s), and confirms successful scheduling to the Auctioneer.

If the Auctioneer needs to locate specific inventory items, they may use the search filters (e.g., Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone) or sort the list by clicking on underlined column headers before selecting items.
The Auctioneer may choose to export the current list of selected or filtered items to Excel instead of immediately creating an auction.
If the Auctioneer wishes to remove previously selected items from the batch, they can check the 'Remove checked items from this auction' option in the Action menu.

If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with invalid or missing required parameters (e.g., no items selected, invalid start/end times), the system will not process the request and may display an error message.
If the 'Create New Auction' button is clicked but no items are currently selected in the list, the system prevents the creation of an empty auction event.
New auction events are created and scheduled in the system with the configured parameters (Start Time, End Time, Duration, Reserve Price).
The selected inventory items are assigned to the newly created auction event(s) and are no longer available for selection in other unscheduled batches (implied by 'Auction Eligible' status change).
The system confirms the successful creation of the auction event(s) to the Auctioneer.
